title: Same-Visit Estimate Allowance by Source Estimate Total, Workmanship Warranties
content:
**Schedule.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, a same-visit estimate allowance is added into the same-visit courtesy sum on a Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty or Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty. The same-visit estimate allowance follows the estimate total written on the estimate booking, held under Repair Estimates & Appointments, that was converted into the customer-pay repair the coverage was issued on, held under Customer-Pay Repairs:

| Estimate total written on that booking | Same-visit estimate allowance |
|---|---|
| the large estimate total, USD 8000, or more | the large-estimate allowance, USD 6.00 |
| the mid estimate total, USD 4000, or more, but under USD 8000 | the mid-estimate allowance, USD 3.00 |
| under USD 4000 | none |
| no such booking | none |

## Locating the booking

The Customer-Pay Repairs order the coverage was issued on names the Repair Estimates & Appointments booking converted into it; the estimate total is the one written on that booking.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical totals)

| Estimate total | Allowance |
|---|---|
| USD 3999.99 | none |
| USD 4000.00 | USD 3.00 |
| USD 7999.99 | USD 3.00 |
| USD 8000.00 | USD 6.00 |

A coverage issued on an insurance claim repair has no customer-pay source repair and therefore no such booking: no allowance.
